Initial release of Reivo — LLM cost optimizer.

- Smartly routes LLM requests to cut API costs by 40–60%.
- Tracks real-time costs per session, agent, and model.
- Enforces budget caps and sends alerts at specific thresholds.
- Detects and auto-stops agent loops using prompt hashing.
- Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google with one base URL change.
- Provides easy setup, commands for cost/status reports, and configurable routing modes.
